vector_memory.semantic_summary: SpherePrimitive is a class inheriting from MeshData responsible for procedurally generating the geometric data for a sphere mesh. It calculates vertices, surface normals, and UV coordinates by iterating over spherical coordinates (latitude/stacks and longitude/slices). The constructor constructs triangle indices to form a closed, counter-clockwise winding mesh representation suitable for 3D rendering pipelines.
